notes.title: Small Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone and thank you for buying the game !
Thank you for your great feedback regarding the game. I submitted small hotfix. 

I'm working on reducing the loading time, I understand it's a big concern. I will also bring Joystick binding. For now the game is designed for Keyboard / Mouse only.

 Made AI a little harder in every mode  (Small reminder : you can change the AI difficulty in the menu (press M)
 Showing binding button next to ladder in first level (Press E)
 Pressing “B” was pausing the game, its fixed now.
 Increased “Happiness bar” Size in the office


For other binding questions, please press "TAB" in the game you'll see a panel appearing on the left of your screen and also a panel called "help" during the sex scenes.

Feel free to join Discord & talk to me directly if you have some questions or requests !
